author.name: Hammad Ulhaq
author.role: Head of Supply Chain · 20+ yrs FMCG & Beverages

slides.title: Stop fixing the same miss *twice*
slides.body: A root cause playbook for planners and warehouse leads

slides.title: What the 5 Whys *is*
bullets: Ask why, then ask why of that answer
Stop at a process you can change
Usually 3 to 5 rounds, not exactly five

slides.title: Write the miss as a *fact*
bullets: What, where, when and how much
Illustrative: one SKU missed two trucks

slides.title: Ask why with the *floor*
bullets: Bring the picker, planner and driver
Every answer needs evidence: a report or scan

slides.title: One missed truck, *five* whys
bullets: Not loaded → pick face empty → top-up late
Top-up late → min level in system is old
Old min level → no owner after a pack change

slides.title: Fix the process, not the *person*
bullets: Name an owner and a review date
Change the rule, SOP or master data
Check in 30 days: did it come back?

slides.title: If it comes back, you fixed a *symptom*
slides.body: Save this for your next review.
